 UAE / Education UAE education ministry denies circulating first-term exam timetable
 Parents and students are urged to check the ministry's official channels for exam updates
 Last updated: October 31, 2026 | 13:28 Huda Ata , Special to Gulf News 1 MIN READ Add as a preferred source on Google The ministry confirmed that it had neither issued an official circular to schools containing the timetable nor published it through its official channels. Supplied Abu Dhabi: The UAE Ministry of Education has denied the authenticity of a timetable for first-term examinations for the 2026–2027 academic year that has been circulating on social media groups for several days.
 The ministry confirmed that it had neither issued an official circular to schools containing the timetable nor published it through its official channels.
 Get updated faster and for  FREE : Download the  Gulf News  app now - simply  click here . Responding to an enquiry about the circulating timetable, the ministry said the information was inaccurate and was not based on any official circular issued by the ministry.
 It urged parents and students to refrain from sharing unverified examination timetables or information and to obtain updates concerning examinations exclusively through its official channels.
